question: What happens when the thing rises in the heart?
premises: There towardness, that thing collision of thing.
By fullness entry, limited mind dissolution in Shiva.
inference: When the thing rises in the heart, limited mind dissolves into Shiva by fullness entry.
plain_english: There towardness, that thing collision of thing; in heart, of rising; by fullness entry, limited mind dissolution in Shiva.
